Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.xml

Class XmlElement

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.xml.XmlElement
public final class XmlElement extends Object
Located XML node used by pluggable object factories.

Stores an immutable attribute map alongside parse-time child/text buffers. Typed accessors validate finite numbers and strict booleans; error() includes line, element and optional id.
